items.title: 让 lab_run 为 reviewer 目标产出真实 candidate patch artifact
items.context: 没有 patch artifact 的 promote 结果不够闭环。需要把 baseline ref 与当前 workspace 之间的真实 diff 落到 run 目录，供 compare/promote 复用。

happy.desc: 修改 reviewer prompt 后运行 lab_run → run 目录写出真实 patch.diff，并且 patch 内容对应 baseline ref 到当前 workspace 的改动

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/lab-reviewer-mvp.json:4 — case runs patch-happy and verifies run-001 writes a real patch.diff whose content matches the reviewer prompt delta | severity:info

edge.desc: 当前 workspace 没有改动 reviewer target 时运行 lab_run → patch.diff 为空或缺席，结果明确说明没有 candidate patch

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/lab-reviewer-mvp.json:18 — case runs patch-none and proves no-op reviewer changes leave candidatePatch empty and the run rejected, covering the no-patch edge path | severity:info

adversarial.desc: patch 里混入 editableFiles 之外的路径 → reviewer MVP 仍然被 patch policy 拦截，不会把脏 patch 带进 promote

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/lab-reviewer-mvp.json:33 — case runs patch-policy-reject and confirms a protected-path diff is rejected by patch policy before it can be promoted | severity:info

items.title: 补强 compare promote 输出，让 reviewer MVP 对 patch 与结果说真话
items.context: compare/promote 不应只返回 run id 和 summary 路径，还要带上 patch 路径、baseline ref 和 kept 原因，才能支撑 reviewer MVP 的真实使用。
relatedDocs: AGENTS.md#用户价值验收（优先于技术链路验证）

happy.desc: 存在 kept reviewer run 时调用 lab_compare/lab_promote → 输出包含 baseline ref、delta、decision 和 promotePatch 路径

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/lab-reviewer-mvp.json:48 — case runs compare-promote-happy and verifies compare/promote both expose baseline ref plus patch path for a kept reviewer run | severity:info

edge.desc: compare 选 best run 时遇到同分候选 → 按 tieBreak 选择复杂度更低的 run，并在输出中保持稳定

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/lab-reviewer-mvp.json:63 — case runs compare-tiebreak and proves equal-score runs are resolved by lower-complexity tieBreak, keeping compare output stable | severity:info

adversarial.desc: candidate run 被 rejected 或 patch 缺失时调用 lab_promote → 明确拒绝，不会伪装成 ready_for_review

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/lab-reviewer-mvp.json:78 — case runs promote-rejected and confirms patchless or rejected runs cannot masquerade as ready_for_review | severity:info

items.title: 为 reviewer 目标补上端到端回归验证
items.context: 需要有针对真实 reviewer target 的 verify 脚本与 fixture，证明从修改 prompt、生成 patch、运行评分到 promote 输出是一条完整闭环。

happy.desc: 真实 reviewer target 的 verify 脚本从修改 prompt 到 promote 全链跑通 → 返回 kept 和 patch artifact

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/lab-reviewer-mvp.json:93 — case runs verify-happy and proves the end-to-end reviewer flow reaches kept plus patch artifact output | severity:info

edge.desc: reviewer prompt 改动不足以超过 minScoreGain → verify 显示 compare 为 rejected 且 promote 失败

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/lab-reviewer-mvp.json:108 — case runs verify-rejected and shows insufficient reviewer gains stay rejected and fail promotion | severity:info

adversarial.desc: reviewer prompt 加入 crash/volatile marker → verify 仍然记录 score 与 stability 结果，但不会错误 promote

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/lab-reviewer-mvp.json:123 — case runs verify-volatile and records score/stability data without allowing volatile reviewer runs to promote | severity:info
